# National Gallery of Art

> > National Gallery of Art's digital resources, featuring the Samuel H. Kress Collection digital archive and institutional services.

The National Gallery of Art (NGA) maintains specialized digital resources including comprehensive archives of its renowned art collections. The Kress Collection represents one of the most significant assemblages of European art in the museum's holdings.

## Key Topics

- Samuel H. Kress Collection
- National Gallery of Art
- European art
- Digital archives
- Museum collections
- Art history
- Kress Foundation
- Archival materials
- Authentication services (ADFS)

## Digital Archives & Collections

- [Kress Collection Digital Archive](https://kress.nga.gov/): Digital archive of Samuel H. Kress Collection at National Gallery of Art

## Optional

- [Error](https://adfs.nga.gov/adfs/ls/): ADFS authentication error page for NGA services
